pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Small bug fix to existing search. It has one obvious design, and the PR describes the literal-matching change as intended.
No spec file in this change.
New tests cover %, _, a mixed '0% o' query and a backslash. Each would fail without the escaping. I did not run them: the cloudflare:workers pool is probably unavailable here, and CI runs them.
The diff touches no docs, and no docs mention the search's LIKE behaviour.
The escape regex escapes backslash first, via a single-pass replace. ESCAPE '\' in the JS string is ESCAPE '\' in SQL, which is correct. The query is still parameterised. No other LIKE use in src.
The query stays bound-parameter, so no injection. Escaping removes wildcard abuse.
The diff touches no UI files.

The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE added, the three characters escaped, a new test, no tests deleted.
